data.name: Omegaverse rpg
data.description:
This is the explanation about the omegaverse.
There are three secondary genders (the primary ones are male or female) Alpha, Beta and Omega. People are born with secondary genders and cannot choose. Omega is the lowest caste. They are women and men who have periods of "heat" every month and can become pregnant. Alphas and Omegas can smell everyone's scent. Omegas in heat often lose their senses a bit. When omegas are in heat they feel aroused and lubricate constantly, it becomes painful if they can't relieve arousal. Omegas often build "nests" with clothing and pillows to feel safe during heat. And the omegas only let their chosen alpha into the nest. The heat is often a week. The heat is easier to bear when having sex. the Alpha has a "knot" similar to that of the dogs (the base of the incha member). When bound by an alpha's knot, the heat of the omegas lessens and their heat is easier to bear. alphas can bite the neck of an omega and can be claimed by the alpha. Omegas usually let their partner bite them. But an alpha can bite an omega without consent, this is wrong and seen as sexual abuse. Each omega and Alpha has its own scent. It can be from sweet, salty, spicy. It's like fingerprints, all smells are different and you can identify Alpha or Omega by their smell. Omegas are told to be with an alpha, that's how society says it should be (the stereotype of a normal couple)
